text.description_html:
Global TC805 Series Compact Hydraulic Door Closer

The Global TC805 Series is a great alternative for use on interior and light weight exterior door applications.

Hydraulic closer for interior hollow core wood, solid wood and metal doors up to 85 lbs. Use on doors up to 3 feet wide and 7 feet high. Can be used for specialty applications.

Rugged, steel cylinder housing and adjustable arm for smooth, quiet and safe operating.

Reversible for left and right hand doors. Closer can also be mounted parallel arm.

Global TC805 Closer Specifications:

  • Maximum door size: 36 inches interior
  • Maximum door size: 30 inches exterior
  • Maximum door weight: 85 lbs
  • Spring Tension: #2
  • Body Length: 3-1/2"
  • Body Height: 3-1/2"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 3"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 1-1/8"
  • Non-Handed
  • UL and ULC rated - Fire code approved

Gray Aluminum Finish.
